book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: بالليل، زحفوا بين الشجر لحد المعبد.
sentences.en: At night, they crawled among the trees to the temple.

sentences.ar: معبد قديم، وحواليه حرس، والنار مشعولة.
sentences.en: An old temple, guards around it, fires burning.
And the priests drunk on liquor, and asleep.
And Aouda inside the temple, between two guards.
Fogg said: we go in by the door.
And they approached.
And the guards woke.
And they fell back.
The guide said: through the wall.

sentences.ar: وحفروا بالحيط الخلفي، بسكاكين، ساعة كاملة.
sentences.en: And they dug at the back wall, with knives, a whole hour.
Stone by stone.
And then a sound from inside.
The guards got up.
And they stopped.

sentences.ar: قال السير فرانسيس: ما في طريقة.
sentences.en: Sir Francis said: there is no way.
It is over.
And Fogg said: not yet.
The sun has not risen.
And Passepartout vanished.
With dawn, the drums began.

sentences.ar: والناس اجتمعوا، وجابوا عودا، وهي ماشية زي النايمة.
sentences.en: And the people gathered, and brought Aouda, walking as if asleep.

sentences.ar: وطلعوها على كومة الحطب، جنب جثة الأمير.
sentences.en: And put her on the pile of wood, beside the rajah's body.

sentences.ar: وفوغ رفع سكينه، وكان رح يركض.
sentences.en: And Fogg raised his knife, and was about to run.
And Sir Francis held him.
And they lit the fire.
And the smoke rose.
And suddenly, the people screamed, and fell to the ground.
Because the dead rajah had risen.

sentences.ar: وقف بين الدخان، وحمل عودا بإيديه.
sentences.en: He stood in the smoke, and lifted Aouda in his arms.

sentences.ar: ونزل من الحطب، ومشى بين الناس.
sentences.en: And came down from the wood, and walked among the people.

sentences.ar: والناس وجوههم عالأرض، ما حدا تجرأ يتطلع.
sentences.en: And the people's faces on the ground, no one daring to look.
And reached Fogg and Sir Francis.
And said in a low voice: run!
It was Passepartout.

sentences.ar: لبس تياب الميت، وتمدد مكانه بالدخان، واستنى.
sentences.en: He had put on the dead man's clothes, lain in his place in the smoke, and waited.
